[[Slateport City]] }} '''The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon V''' (Japanese: '''VS カイオーガ & グラードン V''' ''VS Kyogre & Groudon V''), titled '''VS Kyogre & Groudon V''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 237th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 57th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}. It is subtitled '''Forgotten Memories''' (Japanese: '''甦る記憶''' ''Resurrected Memories'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Memories Once More''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} Having learned that the real opponents are at the [[Seafloor Cavern]], {{adv|Sapphire}} sends out {{p|Wailord|Lorry}} and decides to go there and put an end to this. [[Winona]] questions this plan, as even though they know where their opponents are, they have no means of getting underwater. Back at [[Brawly]] and [[Roxanne]]'s location, they continue to have trouble against {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}}, who merely toys with them. Brawly tries to fight it with his {{p|Machoke}}, but Groudon easily swats it away. Although Brawly knows that his Pokémon is not weak, he concedes that Groudon is too strong. At [[Wattson]] and [[Flannery]]'s location, {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}} continues to attack the [[Gym Leader]] duo. Wattson has his {{TP|Wattson|Manectric}} {{m|Charge|store up electricity}} and release it as an attack. The attack has no effect, as Kyogre instinctively raised its defenses with {{m|Calm Mind}}. Back in [[Slateport City]], [[Wallace]] arrives to rescue [[Captain Stern]], [[Gabby and Ty|Gabby, and Ty]] from the flooding. Stern gets worried and wishes that {{Steven}} were here to help them. When Stern asks Wallace if he knows where Steven is, Wallace replies with a no. Gabby asks where {{adv|Ruby}} is, to which Wallace reveals that he put him in a first-aid center along with the other flood victims. Ruby soon wakes up at the center, and gets confused at his surroundings. He quickly remembers about what he said to [[Feefee]] and goes out to find her again. He notices the [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman]] and [[Dock]] and notes that they seem to be suffering from a disease. He notices Wallace, Stern, Gabby, and Ty coming into the building as well and hides. Ruby notes his behavior and berates himself for hiding and running away all this time. Ruby eavesdrops as Wallace and the others are about to contact Winona. Upon calling her, Wallace apologizes to Winona for acting without her orders. Winona states that does not matter, as the two [[Legendary Pokémon]], {{p|Groudon}} and {{p|Kyogre}} have already awakened. After learning that Brawly, Roxanne, Flannery, and Wattson are fighting the two Pokémon, Wallace decides to go and join them. Winona stops him, as she reveals that fighting Groudon or Kyogre will not solve anything. When Wallace asks why, Winona reveals that the only way to stop the Pokémon is to defeat the person controlling them at the [[Seafloor Cavern]]. Ruby sees Sapphire on the video screen, and notes that she has a new Pokémon, which he vaguely remembers seeing before. Overhearing their conversation, Ruby learns that it is impossible for them to reach their enemy without a submarine. Ruby flashes back to what [[Mr. Briney]] told him, and quickly remembers {{p|Relicanth|Relly}} is the Pokémon that has the ability to dive down to the deepest depths of the ocean. ==Major events== * {{adv|Sapphire}} decides to go to the [[Seafloor Cavern]] to stop their enemies. * The [[Gym Leader]]s continue to battle {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}} and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}}, but to no avail. * {{adv|Ruby}} regains consciousness. * Ruby finds out that Kyogre and Groudon are being controlled by someone. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Ruby}} * {{adv|Sapphire}} * [[Roxanne]] * [[Brawly]] * [[Wattson]] * [[Flannery]] * [[Winona]] * [[Wallace]] * [[Gabby and Ty]]/{{tt|Maryann and Tyler|Chuang Yi}} * [[Mr. Briney]] (flashback) * [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman]] * [[Captain Stern]] * [[Dock]]/{{tt|Tuga|Chuang Yi}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Feebas}} ([[Feefee]]/{{tt|Mimi|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Ruby}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Wailord}} ({{tt|Lorry|Viz Media}}/{{tt|Walo|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Sapphire}}'s) * {{p|Tropius}} ([[Troppy]]/{{tt|Pilo|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Sapphire}}'s) * {{p|Relicanth}} (Relly/{{tt|Relo|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Sapphire}}'s) * {{p|Graveler}} ([[Roxanne]]'s) * {{p|Machoke}} ([[Brawly]]'s) * {{p|Manectric}} ({{OP|Wattson|Manectric}}) * {{p|Magcargo}} ([[Flannery]]'s) * {{p|Altaria}} ({{OP|Winona|Altaria}}) * {{p|Kyogre}} ({{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre|Adventures}}) * {{p|Groudon}} ({{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon|Adventures}}) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * In the [[Chuang Yi]] version, the move {{m|Calm Mind}} is incorrectly translated as {{m|Meditate}}.
